translations.web: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
translations.kjv: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
translations.asv: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah. Psalm 28 A Psalm of David.
